thread:
anna: Quick recap from this morning's all-hands — thanks for joining. Major callouts: 1) brief incident summary (storage tier outage) and mitigations, 2) updated trial data retention defaults, 3) SLO playbook pilots kicking off. Recording + links below.

raj: storage incident note: brief outage of the cold-tier blob store at 09:12; automated failover worked but some background jobs retried and caused elevated queueing until 09:28. Full postmortem will be in the incidents channel.

infra_bot: Incident stub created: https://incidents.redwood/2233445566-storage-tier-outage. Immediate mitigation: increased retry backoff + temporary route to warm tier.

emma: thanks for the quick turnaround team. ops: any customer-facing impact? did any beta customers see errors?

raj: small number of Dedicated beta jobs retried; no customer-visible API errors. Partner-eng notified two partners; both acknowledged. We'll include a short blurb in the postmortem.

legal_team: note re: retention change: trial orgs default non-PII retention shortened to 14d. Paid contracts unaffected unless amended. Legal will provide suggested contract language for EU/regulatory asks.

marketing_bot: recording uploaded: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2233445566-allhands.mp4. Slides + appendix: https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2233445566-slides.pdf

jasper: SLO playbook pilots — forming three cross-functional pods (serving/runtime/ops). Kickoff next Wed 11am PT. Please nominate one rep per pod by Friday.

anna: action items captured in follow-ups doc: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2233445566-followups. Owners: raj (postmortem), emma (customer comms draft), jasper (playbook reps), marketing_bot (external blurb draft).

emma: I'll draft the partner-friendly incident note and post to the partner channel by EOD.

raj: postmortem ETA EOD tomorrow. We'll include timeline, root cause (regression in the cold-tier GC logic), and follow-up actions (improve canarying + reduce aggressive retries).

marketing_bot: suggested external bullets for the blog: 1) Optimize beta continues with minimal disruption thanks to automated failover; 2) Trials default to shorter retention for non-PII to reduce risk; 3) New SLO playbooks to improve oncall readiness and reliability.

anna: good. please avoid technical details in external blurb; partners/customers get a sanitized summary. legal_team, confirm wording for EU language and I'll approve.

legal_team: confirming EU wording now, will add to follow-ups doc.

jasper: reminder: SLO template will be posted in the follow-ups doc (objective, metric, alert thresholds, warm fallback, escalation path). Feedback welcome.

infra_bot: Transcript: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/2233445566.txt

anna: thanks everyone. if you couldn't make it, watch the recording and add follow-ups in the doc. We'll post the postmortem link in #incidents when ready and do a short update in #product after the playbook kickoff.
